title: Fix count of unpromotable refreshes in test

timeline.message:
Fix count of unpromotable refreshes in test

Fixes #93401
timeline.author: Iraklis Psaroudakis

reply.body:
Hi @idegtiarenko , no it's randomly between 1 and 2.

Basically, 1 means that it's the primary, and 2 means there's another indexing replica that is promotable to primary. The remaining replicas are unpromotable/search shards.
